question: On real cross-rescan indoor geometry, does a complete registered door or doorframe extent repair the portal-IoU and centroid failure caused by an edge-clipped reference fragment?

predecessor.observed_gap: Strict z-buffer visibility repaired the local reference plane, but every selected SceneNN reference credential was an image-edge-clipped 66-118 px fragment without the complete portal centre or boundary.

information_change: Replace only the incomplete reference extent with a complete provider-annotated door or doorframe instance shared between a 3RScan reference scan and rescan. Use the official scan-to-reference transform. Do not add an RGB matcher, learned coordinate field, policy learner, or query-side correction.

provider.name: 3RScan / RIO
provider.access_boundary: The researcher must personally accept the non-commercial research Terms of Use and receive access approval. BlindAssist does not accept terms on the researcher's behalf and does not redistribute raw assets.
provider.transform_semantics: Interpret the flat JSON transform with the official C++ Eigen column-major assignment and apply it as rescan-to-reference matrix times homogeneous point.

source_selector.stable_identity_rule: The same local objectId and allowed semantic label must exist in the reference and rescan, and the instance must not occur in removed, nonrigid, rigid, or ambiguity metadata.
required_geometry: objects.json or per-scan semseg.v2.json for metadata inventory
source_selector.ranking: Rank stable candidates by the smaller reference/rescan OBB two-largest-axis area descending, then reference scan ID, rescan ID, and instance ID ascending; greedily retain one endpoint per reference scene.

partial_fragment.meaning: Controlled ablation of the SceneNN extent failure, not a claimed sensor-visible mask.
partial_fragment.rule: Fit one deterministic upright portal frame from the complete reference instance and retain only the positive-edge 25 percent of its horizontal width.

complete_credential.rule: Use every provider-labelled reference instance vertex without query-side fitting or correction.

evaluator.query_truth: Transform the complete provider-labelled rescan target instance into the reference coordinate system. Query target geometry and other rescan door instances are evaluator-only.
evaluator.portal_frame: Use +Z as vertical and the dominant XY principal direction of the complete reference instance as horizontal.
evaluator.extent_metric: Convex planar extent IoU in the frozen reference portal frame.
evaluator.identity_metric: Rank all rescan door or doorframe instances by 3D centroid distance from the predicted portal centre.

decision_gate.failure_semantics: If the complete arm fails, do not train a coordinate field on this source. Diagnose endpoint definition, annotation correspondence, or transform semantics. If it passes, open one reference-conditioned pixel-transfer successor.

stop_condition: One metadata-and-geometry source freeze over the authorized train split, then one three-endpoint replay. Do not repeat Hypersim, inspect the 3RScan test split, tune the crop fraction or gates, or train a learned transfer before this result.
claim_boundary: A pass is a real indoor cross-rescan provider-geometry Development ceiling showing that complete registered extent carries decision-changing endpoint-centre and boundary information. Both prediction and evaluation use privileged 3RScan geometry and official registration. It is not RGB perception, reference-coordinate learning, doorway aperture, opening state, access, traversability, approach waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, or mobility-safety evidence.
